page.layout: One column of running text, with short quotation-continuation marks («) printed in the right margin beside each line. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: la, & latè patet, & ad multos pertinet, & summo in honore semper fuit, & clarissimi ciues ei studio etiam hodie præsunt. Verùm hæc quidē hactenus: ex quibus, cuius-modi Iurisconsultorum munus, quibusque in rebus positum fuerit, satis explicatum esse arbitramur: intelligiqué simul ex ijs putamus, quam-obrem traditam à Cicerone in lib. de Orat. 1[?], Iurisconsulti definitionē secutus non sim, ubi scribit: Iurisconsultum esse, qui legum & consuetudinis eius qua priuati in ciuitate utuntur, & ad respondendum, & ad agendum, & ad ca-

page.notes: The « marks in the right margin are quotation-continuation marks printed beside each line, not text, so they are not transcribed. "Orat. 1" is uncertain: the numeral may be I or 1. "Summo" in the line "in honore" is read as printed "summo"; the first line's word "summo" is clear. Words broken at line ends with no printed hyphen (munus, positum) are written whole. Hyphen "cuius-" and "quam-" are printed hyphens kept.
